comment: Format comparison, 30s of real webcam footage (corpus-real/cam720.mkv) at 320x240@24, all quality metrics are SSIM (All) computed in RGBA domain against the identical source frames. x264=libx264 preset veryfast, AV1=libsvtav1 preset 10, both fed yuv420p. QOV rows measured with bench_stream.c (demo settings: yuv420 q60 motion+ikf+refresh+lz4 kf120). Decode: QOV single-threaded CLI incl. per-frame SHA-256; ffmpeg decode is multithreaded with hand-tuned asm.

qov_q80.note: quality knob saturates at this resolution

opus_16k_mono_typical.note: libopus voip typical; analytic, not measured (no speech fixture)

verdict: At matched SSIM ~0.81, x264 needs ~8 kbps where QOV q60 needs 557 kbps (~70x). At SSIM ~0.95, x264 is 35 kbps. AV1 is more efficient still. QOV buys simplicity (single-header, 3 bit-exact implementations), determinism and license freedom at a large compression cost; decode is ~10x realtime single-threaded at 320x240.
